references.phrase: locally ringed spaces X and Y

references.context: Sheaf theory: morphism of sheaves on Y into pushforward of a sheaf on X
Commutative algebra and sheaf theory: induced maps on stalks of structure sheaves preserving maximal ideals

references.disposition: The sheaf map reverses the direction of the underlying continuous map; no ordinary covariant map O_X→O_Y is inferred.

review_rationale: Read all parts of a scheme morphism: continuous underlying map, compatible map of structure sheaves in the contravariant direction, and induced local homomorphisms of stalks.
